frozen_at: 2026-09-22, before any 2025 test-window metric was computed by this study
question: Replace the sportsbook-spread game-script tilt with a football-only margin, and replace the pooled per-market SD with a mean-conditional SD, without using any market input in the player forecast.
data: walk-forward as-played player-week rows (features strictly prior-week), eligible_for_shortlist, actual observed; markets receiving_yards, receptions, rushing_yards, passing_yards, pass_attempts, rush_attempts (anytime_td: margin arms only)

margin_arms.A0_spread: sportsbook spread_line (incumbent live; market-derived; comparator only, never eligible)

margin_rule: A2 becomes the primary margin source iff on the test window the pooled paired dMAE(A2-A1) 95% game-cluster bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 AND no market's dMAE CI lower bound > 0. Otherwise A1 is primary and A2 runs in shadow. A0 is reported and never selected.

dispersion_arms.D0_pooled: incumbent: pooled residual SD of A1 means over all rows before 2025 week 1 (market_residual_sd at the 2025 cutoff)
dispersion_arms.D1_conditional: sd = a*mean^b fitted on calibration window mean deciles (log-log least squares), floored at the smallest bin SD

dispersion_metrics: Brier and log loss at the synthetic trailing-mean line
dispersion_rule: Per market, D1 becomes primary iff on the test window |cov80-0.80| is smaller than D0's AND the paired dBrier(D1-D0) 95% game-cluster bootstrap CI upper bound <= 0. Otherwise D0 stays primary and D1 runs in shadow.
real_line_discovery: 2026 weeks 1-2 settled exact-line rows (latest clock, one row per unique event), D0 vs D1 p_over at the offered point: Brier, log loss, AUC; market no-vig consensus as comparator. DISCOVERY ONLY, not used by any rule.
exclusions: No market price, consensus, spread or total enters any arm eligible for primary. No threshold or parameter is changed after the test window is opened.
